name: pl-fetal-cp-surface-extract
title: Fetal CP Surface Extraction
description: Fetal brain MRI CP surface extraction using CIVET marching-cubes

parameters.name: side
parameters.help: brain hemisphere side. "auto" => infer from file name [choices: left, right, auto, none]

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.help: pattern for file names to include

parameters.name: subsample
parameters.help: Use -subsample option for spehre_mesh, use with narrow sulci

parameters.name: mincmorph_iterations
parameters.help: Number of mincmorph iterations. Mincmorph is a mask preprocessing step which repairs disconnected voxels. A larger value may improve results for messy masks, but at the cost of accuracy.

parameters.name: adapt_object_mesh
parameters.help: Parameters for adapt_object_mesh, which does mesh smoothing.

parameters.name: inflate_to_sphere_implicit
parameters.help: Parameters for inflate_to_sphere_implicit. Larger values are necessary for larger brain size.

parameters.name: keep_mask
parameters.help: Copy input mask file to output directory

parameters.name: no_fail
parameters.help: Exit normally even when failed to process a subject
